messages:
maria: Heads-up — multiple high-sev tickets reporting API 5xx/timeouts on hosted inference since ~08:12 UTC. Customers see gateway 502/504s and long tail latency. Metrics show request queue depth hitting the service cap and continuous-batcher backlog. Any oncall?
raj: :rotating_light: I'm on it. Grafana graph shows a sharp queue_depth spike starting 08:10. Link: https://grafana.redwood/hosted/gateway-queue (shared view).
kim: Seeing repeated errors in gateway logs: `ERROR dequeue: timeout after 120s` and `batcher_queue_full` on hydra-gateway-1/2. Also a flood of long-seq requests holding KV cache.
kevin: Can repro from my laptop: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test long conversation"}'` — gets stuck then 504 after ~2m.
saml-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-314 — severity=high; runbook assigned.
raj: Quick mitigation plan: 1) lower continuous-batcher batch_window 200ms -> 50ms to reduce aggregation latency, 2) temporarily raise request_queue_depth hard limit 2000 -> 3000 for 10m, 3) enable fallback routing to smaller model for hosted tier. Applying now.
maria: Please also enable prefix-KV eviction for longseqs to avoid single requests monopolizing cache. Add a short-term rate-limit for very long sequences from same tenant.
kim: Batch window change applied on cbatch-prod (rolling). queue_depth bumped on gateway-prod. Monitoring p95/p99. Early signs: p95 down ~30%, 5xx count decreasing but a persistent tail remains from longseqs.
kevin: Suggestion: set CONT_BATCH_MAX_SEQ=2048 and CONT_BATCH_EVICT=true so we can evict oldest prefixes on pressure. Also spin up 4 warm worker instances in the dedicated pool to absorb burst.
raj: Enabling eviction and kicking extra workers via infra autoscale API now. Command used: `POST /infra/autoscale?pool=dedicated-prod&add=4` (audit ID 0x7f3).
maria: :thumbsup: Customers reporting fewer 5xx from support thread. I'll post an update to the affected accounts and request they validate. Saving repro steps in INC-2026-314.
kim: Captured logs/snippets for postmortem: `gateway/hydra-gateway-1 stderr: dequeue_timeout seq=67421 tenant=acme-corp` and `cbatch/proc-3 WARN queue_full drop=12`.
raj: Leaving mitigation in place for 30m, will monitor. Next: correlate tenant patterns (longseq heavy) and consider adaptive eviction + per-tenant soft limits. Assigning owners: raj (mitigation + correlates), kim (logs + pmr), maria (customer comms).
saml-bot: Runbook check-in scheduled in 15 minutes.
kevin: If anything regresses, escalate to infra-oncall and flip temporary fallback to tiny-quant model to reduce per-token cost and speed.
maria: Thanks team. I'll file a postmortem draft after stabilization and link INC-2026-314.
